messages:
maya: Quick question — can we summarize the capacity-sim runs for 13B-int4 vs 13B-fp16 across us-west(usw1), us-east(use1), eu-west(euw1)? I need GPU counts, per-GPU concurrency targets, and recommended autoscale headroom for Dedicated pools. Also call out kernel choices (flash/cutlass/triton) impact and any quality regressions from quantization.

cheng: Posted the condensed numbers below (pulled from bench-bot CSV). TL;DR: H100 > A100 > T4 for int4 throughput; int4 shows throughput gains vs fp16 but small eval regressions. Reserve ~25–35% headroom for bursts and failover. details: A100 (p4d-like): 120 req/s per GPU @ p95 ~280ms (int4, conc=8). H100: ~160 req/s @ p95 240ms. T4: ~45 req/s @ p95 420ms. FP16 baseline (A100): ~95 req/s @ p95 360ms. Region delta: euw1 +10–20ms p95 vs usw1 due to network + model cache warmups.

bench-bot: CSV link: https://internal.redwood/bench/178345/summary.csv (cols: region,gpu,model,quant,conc,req_s,p95_ms,notes)

alex: Noted on kernels — for int4 we saw flash_attention + fused-kernels gives best latency on H100 for seq_len<=1024. When seq_len>1024 we hit cutlass fallback on our runtime and latency spikes ~1.6x. Triton kernels were stable but ~5–10% slower on A100 int4 for these models.

sam: Quick config we've been using for Dedicated sim runs:
```
model: redwood/13B
quant: int4
gpu_types: [h100,a100,t4]
concurrency_per_gpu_tested: [4,8,12]
workload: mix_90_short (avg len 120, p99 len 900)
metric: req_s and p95 latency
```
For sizing, recommend target_util=0.65 and max_concurrency_per_gpu=12, autoscale_headroom=0.25. That gives stable p95 under normal load and room to scale on spikes.

maya: Can you call out exact GPU counts for a 10k rps Dedicated pool target? ballpark numbers per region + recommended commit (monthly).

cheng: Ballpark for 10k rps using int4 13B: H100-only pool: ~64 GPUs (10k / 160 req_s ≈ 62.5 -> +30% headroom -> 82 commit). A100-only: ~84 GPUs (10k / 120 ≈ 84 -> +30% -> 110). Mixed pool (50% H100 + 50% A100) ~95 GPUs total with autoscale buffer. T4 not recommended for 10k rps unless cost-driven; would need ~220 T4s.

alex: Caveat: those counts assume conc configured to 8 and batching latency targets satisfied. If app needs lower p95 (e.g., <200ms) then H100 counts go up since you must target lower concurrency. Also watch kernel selection — forcing flash on unsupported seq_len will actually reduce effective throughput.

ops-bot: Note: euw1 GPU inventory is constrained next month; if we plan >40 GPU commit in euw1 we need procurement lead time.

maya: Action items: (1) alex to test kernel combos at seq_len distributions [<=256, 256-1024, 1024-2048] and post microbench numbers; (2) cheng/sam to produce final 10k-rps sizing table per region (usw1/use1/euw1) with per-GPU counts and recommended commit + autoscale policy; (3) i'll run evals on the int4 set to quantify quality regressions and create fallback policy if regression >1% on our eval suite.
